spec.description: Dashboard for local IBC observability

spec.title: Attestor GRPC Latency Avg
spec.description: Arithmetic mean latency in milliseconds of successful requests over the rate interval. Calculated as summed duration rates divided by summed request-count rates; no value when no requests are observed.

spec.expr: sum by (attestor, operation) (rate(attestor_operation_milliseconds_sum{caller="rpc", result="ok"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (attestor, operation) (rate(attestor_operation_milliseconds_count{caller="rpc", result="ok"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.title: Relayer GRPC Latency P90
spec.description: Successful relayer API call latency per method.

spec.title: Relayer GRPC Failures / 5s
spec.description: Estimated failed relayer API calls in the preceding five seconds per method. Nonzero GRPC status means failure; increase extrapolates between scrapes. Only recorded error series are shown; absent series are not zero-filled.

spec.title: Go Memory Used
spec.description: Go runtime memory in use (stack plus other): runtime total memory minus released heap memory. Not process RSS.

spec.title: Goroutines
spec.description: Live Go goroutines per service runtime.

spec.title: CPU Usage
spec.description: Process user plus system CPU consumption per service runtime. 100% equals one fully utilized CPU core; multi-core usage can exceed 100%. Requires OTEL host instrumentation.

spec.title: Allocations/sec
spec.description: Heap allocations per second per service runtime, averaged over Grafana's rate interval. Counts allocation events, not bytes.

spec.title: Sign Requests Rate
spec.description: Sign requests per second, including all results, grouped by runtime, signer, and operation.

spec.title: Sign Request Failures / 5s
spec.description: Estimated failed sign requests in the preceding five seconds, grouped by runtime, signer, and operation. Prometheus increase extrapolates between scrapes; first failures on newly created series may not be captured. Only recorded error series are shown.

spec.title: Signer Latency Avg
spec.description: Arithmetic mean latency in milliseconds for successful sign requests over the rate interval, grouped by runtime, signer, and operation. Uses duration sum divided by request count, avoiding coarse histogram quantile interpolation. No value when no successful requests are observed.

spec.expr: sum by (service_runtime, signer, operation) (rate(signer_operation_milliseconds_sum{result="ok"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (service_runtime, signer, operation) (rate(signer_operation_milliseconds_count{result="ok"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.title: Attestor Latest Height
spec.description: Last successfully observed chain height from each attestor RPC runtime, grouped by runtime and attestor name. Gauge values are displayed directly; max collapses any duplicate series without adding heights.

spec.title: EVM RPC Latency P90
spec.description: Successful reqs only

spec.title: Prover Requests Rate
spec.description: Prover operations per second in the relayer, including successful and failed requests, grouped by chain ID, operation, and client ID.

spec.title: Prover Errors Rate
spec.description: Failed prover operations per second in the relayer, grouped by chain ID, operation, and client ID. Only recorded error series are shown; this is a rate, not an error percentage or five-second failure count.

spec.title: Prover Latency P90
spec.description: P90 duration in milliseconds of successful prover operations in the relayer, grouped by chain ID, operation, and client ID.

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.90, sum by (le, chain_id, operation, client_id) (rate(prover_operation_milliseconds_bucket{service_runtime="relayer", result="ok"}[$__rate_interval])))

spec.title: Packet Batch Size Avg
spec.description: Average packets per PacketProofs request over the rate interval in the relayer, grouped by chain ID, proof kind, and client ID. Includes successful and failed proof attempts; this is prover input batch size, not transaction submission batch size. No value when no batches are observed.

spec.expr: sum by (chain_id, proof_kind, client_id) (rate(packet_batch_size_sum{service_runtime="relayer"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (chain_id, proof_kind, client_id) (rate(packet_batch_size_count{service_runtime="relayer"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.title: Relays Completed / sec
spec.description: Successfully completed relay legs per second, grouped by full source/destination client route and leg type. Arrows show the original packet route, including recv_to_ack; not unique packets. Client IDs are shortened for display only.

spec.expr: sum by (chain_id, dest_chain_id, type, client_id, dest_client_id) (rate(relays_completed_total{service_runtime="relayer"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.title: Packets Pending
spec.description: Current pending packet count per full source/destination client route. Gauge values are displayed directly. Client IDs are shortened for display only.

spec.title: Transactions Submitted / sec
spec.description: Successfully broadcast transactions per second per chain and full client ID. Chain is the transaction destination; client is updated by the transaction. Client IDs are shortened for display only.

spec.title: Relay Duration P90
spec.description: P90 wall-clock duration in seconds of successfully completed relay legs, grouped by full source/destination client route and leg type. Not prover call latency or full round-trip duration. Arrows show the original packet route. Client IDs are shortened for display only.

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.90, sum by (le, chain_id, dest_chain_id, type, client_id, dest_client_id) (rate(relay_duration_seconds_bucket{service_runtime="relayer"}[$__rate_interval])))

spec.title: Transaction Retries / sec
spec.description: Transaction retries per second, grouped by full source/destination client route and relay leg type. Arrows show the original packet route. Client IDs are shortened for display only. Only recorded retry series are shown.

spec.expr: sum by (chain_id, dest_chain_id, type, client_id, dest_client_id) (rate(transaction_retries_total{service_runtime="relayer"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.title: Relay Duration Avg
spec.description: Arithmetic mean wall-clock duration in seconds of successfully completed relay legs over the rate interval, grouped by full source/destination client route and leg type. Arrows show the original packet route. Client IDs are shortened for display only. No value when no completed legs are observed.

spec.expr: sum by (chain_id, dest_chain_id, type, client_id, dest_client_id) (rate(relay_duration_seconds_sum{service_runtime="relayer"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (chain_id, dest_chain_id, type, client_id, dest_client_id) (rate(relay_duration_seconds_count{service_runtime="relayer"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.title: Attestor GRPC Latency P90
spec.description: Successful reqs only

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.90, sum by (le, attestor, operation) (rate(attestor_operation_milliseconds_bucket{caller="rpc", result="ok"}[$__rate_interval])))

spec.title: Attestor GRPC Failures / 5s
spec.description: Estimated RPC failures in the preceding five seconds per attestor. Prometheus increase extrapolates between scrapes; first failures on newly created series may not be captured. Only recorded error series are shown; absent series are not zero-filled.

spec.title: EVM RPC Failures / 5s
spec.description: Estimated EVM RPC failures in the preceding five seconds per chain and error code. Prometheus increase extrapolates between scrapes; first failures on newly created series may not be captured. Only recorded error-code series are shown.

spec.title: Attestor GRPC RPS
spec.description: RPC operations per second per attestor, including successful and failed requests.

spec.title: EVM RPC RPS
spec.description: EVM RPC operations per second per chain, including successful and failed requests.

spec.title: Relayer GRPC RPS
spec.description: Relayer API requests per second, including successful and failed calls.

spec.title: Relayer GRPC Latency Avg
spec.description: Arithmetic mean latency in milliseconds of successful requests over the rate interval. Calculated as summed duration rates divided by summed request-count rates; no value when no requests are observed.

spec.title: IBC Local Metrics
